svg.title: minillm: an LLM inference engine in C++20
svg.desc: A from-scratch Llama-architecture inference engine running SmolLM2-135M end to end. Greedy tokens match a PyTorch oracle exactly; Q8_0 weights are 3.8 times smaller (538 to 143 MB); ASan, UBSan and TSan run in CI. Diagram: tokenizer, embedding, 30 decoder blocks of RMSNorm, attention with RoPE and a KV cache, RMSNorm and a SwiGLU MLP, then the final norm, LM head and sampler.
